title: Blurry Vision
statementMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7a8e5800813b90ad225583cafeb105de7da733a3.png)Please direct your vision to line number $x$. Now, read the word you see on that line. If you struggle, I might have to prescribe eyeglasses.

## Input

The only line contains one integer $x$ ($1 \leq x \leq 11$) — the line number.

## Output

Output the word on line number $x$.

## Note

If you fail to read the first line, even glasses won't save you.
